name: Task_3
description:
Investigate whether a MACE model can learn a silver-dimer reference dataset and support a short bulk-silver simulation. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 checkpoint named by teacher_model in /workspace/models, with dispersion enabled, to label 45 isolated, nonperiodic Ag2 structures with separations from 0.6 to 5.0 Å in 0.1 Å increments. Save the structures, total energies in eV, and complete atomic forces in eV/Å.

Starting from the supplied MACE-MP-0b checkpoint named by student_model in /workspace/models, fine-tune on all 45 labeled structures. Choose and document training settings, numerical precision, and a validation strategy appropriate to this dataset. Quantify energy agreement per atom and force agreement with the teacher before and after training, including aggregate errors and their dependence on separation. Clearly distinguish fitting diagnostics on training data from evidence of generalization. Save a loadable trained checkpoint and training history sufficient to establish that optimization occurred and to reproduce the reported diagnostics.

Build periodic FCC silver using a conventional four-atom cubic cell with lattice parameter 4.09 Å repeated 3 x 3 x 3, giving 108 atoms. Keep the cell fixed and use the fine-tuned model for a 5 ps simulation targeting 300 K. Initialize velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed, remove center-of-mass momentum once, and do not reinitialize velocities during the run. Choose and justify the thermostat, integration timestep, and sampling. Quantify temperature behavior and assess physical stability using energies, forces, and structural evolution. Discuss the limitations of transferring a dimer-trained model to bulk silver; report instability or poor agreement honestly rather than assuming successful transfer.

Record which input checkpoints you used and where the trained model came from. For the MD run, save the cell, positions, momenta, time, potential energy, and forces often enough to repeat the temperature and stability checks.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
